title: StartTaskContactRequest
description: StartTaskContactRequest schema from Amazon Connect Service API

InstanceId.description: The identifier of the Amazon Connect instance.

PreviousContactId.description: The identifier of the previous chat, voice, or task contact.

ContactFlowId.description: The identifier of the contact flow for initiating the tasks.

Name.description: The name of a task that is shown to an agent in the Contact Control Panel (CCP).

Description.description: A description of the task that is shown to an agent in the Contact Control Panel.
Description.example: Call customer back regarding their support case
